resources.string: Outgoing text is kept here when its original chat is unknown or has been replaced. Recovery does not prove whether a message was sent or delivered. Choose a chat to copy the text into its draft. Copying does not send anything or remove the recovered text.
Original chat unknown. Recovery does not prove whether this message was sent or delivered.
Original chat replaced. Recovery does not prove whether this message was sent or delivered.
Delivery status unknown. This message may already have been sent.
Could not load recovered drafts. Refresh to try again.
Could not copy the text. Check the selected chat and its draft before trying again.
The selected chat already has draft text. Nothing was replaced. Keep or clear that draft before copying.
Text copied to the selected chat draft. This action did not send a message or remove the recovered text.
